blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Filipinos will have a three-day weekend for Undas from October 31 to November 2, 2026, with All Saints’ Day falling on Sunday and All Souls’ Day on Monday. The three-day stretch covers Saturday, Oct. 31, Sunday, Nov. 1, and Monday, Nov. 2, giving workers and families an extended period for cemetery visits, family gatherings, and travel. Under Proclamation No. 1006, series of 2025, signed by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., Nov. 1 is a special non-working day for All Saints’ Day, while Nov. 2 is an additional special non-working day for All Souls’ Day.
